Isoform switching — overview and QC

Author

Project

Published

July 30, 2026

1 Scope

This report summarizes post-IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR outputs: four datasets (HT and UT reference transcriptomes), gene-level collapse, and QC figures. Regenerate after running the pipeline and figure script from the project root.

Pipeline order (this report covers through QC; see README for 03–06)

  1. Rscript scripts/01_load_data.R
  2. Rscript scripts/02_gene_level_summary.R
  3. Rscript scripts/02b_qc_snapshot.R (table snapshots)
  4. Rscript scripts/02c_qc_figures.R (this report’s figures)

Render (from project root is typical):

quarto render reports/isoform_switching_overview.qmd

The setup chunk locates the project by walking up until it finds config/config.yml, then sets knitr’s root.dir so results/... paths work.

2 Analysis design (from config/config.yml)

Q1 — WT pre/post LPS (HT reference): primary T_HT (THP1 anchor), supplementary H_HT (primary human).

Q2 — UBL5 / U vs T (UT reference): U_UT vs T_UT.

library(knitr)
source("_setup.R")
cat(reduction_caveat())
ImportantInputs are already reduced to switching genes

All 4 of 4 input ISA objects contain only genes that already pass the gene-level q cutoff (saved after isoformSwitchTestDEXSeq(reduceToSwitchingGenes = TRUE)).

Consequences for everything below: gene counts are genes retained, not genes tested; “present in the other dataset” means retained in that saved object, not tested and non-significant; and any percentage of genes has a denominator that was already selected on the outcome. Overlap between datasets is bounded by how many symbols survive in both objects. No enrichment test against this background is reported. See docs/REVIEW_CHANGES.md.

3 Input provenance

Recorded by 01_load_data.R on every run, alongside results/run_manifest.json (git SHA, R and package versions, thresholds in force).

red_path <- tab("input_object_reduction_check.csv")
if (file.exists(red_path)) {
  knitr::kable(
    read_tab("input_object_reduction_check.csv"),
    digits = 2,
    caption = "Per-dataset input check: are the saved ISA objects already reduced to switching genes?"
  )
} else {
  knitr::asis_output("_Run `Rscript scripts/01_load_data.R` to generate the input check._")
}

4 Gene-level snapshot

One row per gene: 02_gene_level_summary.R collapses disagreeing gene symbols before grouping, so these are gene counts rather than row counts.

require_outputs(
  "qc_snapshot_gene_level.csv",
  "Run scripts/02b_qc_snapshot.R first."
)
                                                                 qc_snapshot_gene_level.csv 
"/Users/samkatz/projects/isoform-switch-pipeline/results/tables/qc_snapshot_gene_level.csv" 
qc <- read_tab("qc_snapshot_gene_level.csv")
knitr::kable(qc, digits = 2, caption = "Per-dataset gene counts and % with novel (PacBio) involvement")

6 Top candidate genes (automated)

top_path <- proj_path("results/tables/qc_top10_genes_per_dataset.csv")
if (file.exists(top_path)) {
  top10 <- read.csv(top_path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  knitr::kable(top10, caption = "Top 10 genes per dataset (heuristic: n switching isoforms, then max |dIF|)")
} else {
  knitr::asis_output("_File missing — run scripts/02b_qc_snapshot.R._\n\n")
}
